channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Remand extended for man suspected of killing heavily pregnant wife
item.description: KOTA TINGGI: The remand for a 35-year-old man suspected of killing his pregnant wife with a mortar last Friday has been extended by six days.

item.title: India's Modi calls for inclusive tech at AI summit
item.description: NEW DELHI: Artificial intelligence must be accessible and inclusive, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi told world leaders and tech CEOs on Thursday, at a summit focused on the fast-evolving technology.

item.title: Hakim Danish shrugs off crash ahead of Moto3 full-season debut
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A crash during winter testing in Spain has done little to dent Hakim Danish’s confidence ahead of his first full campaign in this year’s Moto3 World Championship.

item.title: Gu's exchange with AFP at Winter Olympics goes viral
item.description: LIVIGNO: Eileen Gu is one of the biggest names at the Milan-Cortina Olympics. That’s obvious from how her answer to AFP’s question about her performance at the Games has gone viral.

item.title: Protect national heritage site from 'pasar malam' atmosphere, scholar urges
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A leading historian wants the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building at Dataran Merdeka to be preserved as a strictly stately site, warning that commercial or entertainment activities could tarnish one of the nation’s most important heritage landmarks.

item.title: VentureTech invests RM28mil to boost Malaysia's cybersecurity, digital resilience
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Government-backed impact investment firm VentureTech Sdn Bhd has invested RM28 million into Delta Spike Asia Sdn Bhd and IX Telecom Sdn Bhd, reinforcing Malaysia’s cybersecurity and cross-border digital infrastructure capability.

item.title: India tune up for Super Eights with hard-fought win over the Dutch
item.description: AHMEDABAD: Defending champions India beat a spirited Netherlands team by 17 runs on Wednesday ahead of their meeting with South Africa in the Super Eights of the T20 World Cup.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Actor Qi Razali welcomes first child
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysian actor Qi Razali has announced that he has become a father following the birth of his first child.

item.title: Legal fraternity mourns former CJ Abdul Hamid
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The legal fraternity has expressed condolences over the passing of former chief justice Tun Abdul Hamid Mohamad, remembering a tenure defined by discipline, clarity of reasoning and firm adherence to constitutional principles.

item.title: Five children among 12 killed in China fireworks shop explosion
item.description: BEIJING: Five children were among the 12 people killed in an explosion at a general store selling fireworks in China during the Lunar New Year holiday, state media said Thursday.
